parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The interval type. Valid values:

- Minute5: 5 minutes.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The value cannot be earlier than six months before the current time.
